t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The points will change throughout for different gnomes. Use 1x to test out unknown gnomes and 5x for safe bets. Colour differentiates the gnomes. Anything below 3 is low.  Go with which gnome gives the highest points on average.

vb_textbox.text: The colour of the gnome determines if it gives more or less mushrooms. Try to workout which colour of each pair gives the most.  This can change throughout the game so you may need to shift your approach throughout the game.  3 or less is a low number of mushrooms so if you get 3 or less then try the other colour next time. 5 and above are high numbers of mushrooms.
